subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this grouped one-Claw/one-new-agent schema and read-only planning contract as the base for the linked lifecycle stack?
rationale: The PR creates new CLI, environment, manifest, diagnostic, and machine-readable plan surfaces whose long-term ownership and compatibility cannot be settled by code correctness alone while the RFC remains open.

options.title: Keep Draft Until RFC Acceptance
options.body: Remove the duplicate parsers now, but keep this implementation draft until maintainers accept or narrow the RFC contract and its initial lifecycle scope.

options.title: Sponsor Current Contract
options.body: Approve the grouped schema and read-only plan as the experimental base, then require a current-main rebase and exact-head validation before merging.

options.title: Narrow The First Slice
options.body: Reduce the initial contract to agent and workspace inspection and planning, deferring packages, MCP, cron, or integrity commitments until their owners are approved.

recommendation.title: Keep Draft Until RFC Acceptance
recommendation.body: Remove the duplicate parsers now, but keep this implementation draft until maintainers accept or narrow the RFC contract and its initial lifecycle scope.

likelyOwner.reason: Their detailed review supplied the product and schema boundaries adopted by the current implementation and RFC.
